planets.name: Kepler-13 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-13 with a 1.76-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: Kepler-13 b was found in 2011 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around Kepler-13. Its orbit and size follow Esteves et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname ESTEVES_ET_AL__2015): disc_year 2011, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 1.7635874737, pl_radj 1.512, pl_bmassj 9.28

quotes.title: Kepler-13
quotes.card: Kepler-13 or KOI-13 is a triple star system consisting of Kepler-13A, around which an orbiting hot Jupiter exoplanet was discovered with the Kepler space telescope in 2011, and Kepler-13B a common proper motion companion star which has an additional star orbiting it.

thermal.band: the Kepler, Ks, 3.6 µm and 4.5 µm bands together
thermal.facility: Kepler, Palomar WIRC and Spitzer IRAC
thermal.source: Shporer et al. 2014, the temperature of a black body showing the same occultation depths in all four bands
thermal.chosen: the paper's own value; Esteves et al. 2015's Kepler-band 3,490 K assumes no reflected light and is not used
